# ankra_application_provenance_policy (Resource)

An application's own deploy provenance mode (`ankra application provenance set`), which wins over the organisation's default: `off`, `warn` (deploy and file a finding for an image without verified provenance) or `enforce` (refuse such a deploy and pin verified images to their digest). Setting it needs `security.manage`. Verifying a deploy's provenance stays imperative (`ankra application provenance verify`). Destroy leaves the mode as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_provenance_policy" "web" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id
  mode           = "enforce"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `mode` (String) `off`, `warn` or `enforce`.

### Read-Only

- `effective_mode` (String) The mode the application's deploys use now.
- `id` (String) The application id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application id.
terraform import ankra_application_provenance_policy.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
